full: A feature tells people what a product has. A benefit tells them why it matters. Take a fictional backpack. Water-resistant fabric is the feature. Keeping your notebook dry on a drizzly commute is the benefit. In an ad, show the situation. Connect the feature to a useful outcome and support the claim. Do not promise waterproof protection when the material is only water resistant. Clear marketing makes the difference visible.
